note: Rustic recreation area in the Ghost Public Land Use Zone, 13 km west of Cochrane on Hwy 1A then 36 km north on Hwy 40 (gravel, passable by normal vehicle). RV/tent sites in mature forest; picnic shelter. Alberta Parks and the operator both say registered campers may ride from their campsites onto the designated OHV trails. Operated by Red Rock Sawmills. --Claude
summary: AP page (updated Jun 5, 2026) + Red Rock Sawmills page: 53 unserviced at C$40, FCFS, May 1 - Oct 14, vault toilets, non-potable pump; confirmed. OHV drop candidate (ride-out from sites). Creekside recommended down to not waterfront. Pin OK.
flags: OHV DROP CANDIDATE (agency + operator own wording): Alberta Parks: 'Registered campers may off-load and travel to OHV trails from their campsites.' Red Rock Sawmills: 'Off-Highway Vehicle Access: Designated OHV trails nearby (please respect trail use guidelines). You can exit right from your campsite.'
